entries.title: Psalms 12:4
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Prevail - By raising and spreading evil reports concerning him. Our own - At our own disposal to speak what we please, who can control or restrain us?

entries.title: Psalms 12:5
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Puffeth - From him that despises him, and hopes to destroy him with a puff of breath.

entries.title: Psalms 12:6
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Pure - Without the least mixture of falsehood; and therefore shall infallibly be fulfilled.

entries.title: Psalms 12:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Thou shalt keep them - Thy words or promises: these thou wilt observe and keep, both now, and from this generation for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 12:8–13:1
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Walk - They fill all places, and go about boldly and securely.
